turns.text: Hello, I want to return a print and get the money back. I ordered the wrong size.
Please send your order number and the email address you used to place the order so I can check whether the print is eligible for a return and refund.
The order is SC-3744 and the email is claire.fontaine@example.com.

A colleague will take over to review your return and refund for order SC-3744. The refund amount requires staff review, so no return or refund has been approved yet. Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, and you pay the return postage.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

input.summary: Verified customer claire.fontaine@example.com wants to return a print ordered in the wrong size for a refund. The return policy check flagged a large refund requiring staff review. No return request was filed.
